design_blocks.rationale: OpenAI Chat Completions research bot moves to GPT-5.5 on the bedrock-runtime CRIS path. Clarify confirmed a web_search requirement (user), which requires the Responses API on bedrock-mantle; by explicit API-continuity decision (Step 0.8 rule 1b) the Chat Completions API is kept on bedrock-runtime and Web Search is dropped and disclosed as a capability gap rather than recorded as a silent mantle_openai_chat row.

capability_gaps: web_search confirmed in Clarify (user) requires the Responses API on bedrock-mantle; the Chat Completions API was kept on bedrock-runtime by explicit decision (Step 0.8 rule 1b) and Web Search is not provided
bedrock_models.endpoint_assumption: No Mantle-only requirement was recorded for wl_openai_research_bot; bedrock-runtime selected. If this workload needs background inference, server-side tools, Projects/Workspaces, or single-Region processing, re-run Clarify.

text_generation.notes: The runtime OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API covers the detected usage; Web Search is a server-side tool on bedrock-mantle Responses only and was dropped by explicit decision.

code_migration.dependency_changes: openai>=2.45.0 with aws_bedrock_token_generator for the OpenAI client; base URL and model id change only.
